sources.title: Daredevil Cry Baby Fuzz Wah — Daredevil website
sources.excerpt: $229.00 sold out “you did an awesome job with this pedal. It’s my favorite wah I own now. The sweep is so smooth and has the vocal growl I love to hear in a wah. The wah itself is worth the price of admission alone, but the fuzz is so damn cool. I love it, and thanks for the awesome pedal!“ - Ted M. Alright everybody… here it is! The result of almost 3 years of collaboration with Dunlop, I am beyond proud to announce the Daredevil Cry Baby Fuzz Wah. After years of building these as one-offs on the side for friends and fellow musicians… this original design has been given the love it deserves and is now available from Dunlop. These are wired with through-hole components, true bypass switching, and brandishing all custom artwork by Casey Sass who is the man behind almost all Daredevil artwork for the last decade. Get all the dirty details from watching the video… I am not building these in Chicago at my shop , but occasionally i will have some on hand that will be avail for purchase right here. If it doesn’t say SOLD OUT…. go ahead and place an order, they will be signed and dated along with the usual Daredevil box candy. I hope you love these as much as we do, please tag Daredevil in any posts and be sure to follow our other socials as well. YouTube Channel CLICK HERE Instagram CLICK HERE Johnny is the f’n man. Best rock n roll pedal designer and this collab is on point. Get it and throw your other wahs on reverb. - P.C. Sold Out Added! “you did an awesome job with this pedal.
